brand.name: Ultimate pay
brand.slogan: We don't sell a service, we build a future.

login.title: Log In
login.subtitle: Access Yemen's unified ERP & Bank gateway

otp.title: Verify Your Identity
otp.subtitle: We emailed a 6-digit code to your registered email address. Please enter it below.

forgot.title: Forgot Password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email address and we will send you a secure link to reset your credentials.

sent.title: Check Your Email
sent.subtitle: We have sent a secure password reset link to your email address. Please check your inbox and click the link to continue.

reset.title: Create New Password
reset.subtitle: Set a secure, unique password for accessing your merchant aggregator workspace.
reset.hint: Minimum 8 characters, including letters and numbers.
reset.mismatch: Passwords must match and include letters and numbers.

resetSuccess.title: Password updated
resetSuccess.subtitle: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new credentials.

setPassword.title: Set Your Password
setPassword.subtitle: Approved accounts created by a Platform Operator use a temporary password once — set your own to finish activation.
setPassword.invalid: That temporary password isn't valid, or was already used. Ask the Platform team to resend it.

acceptInvitation.title: Accept Your Invitation
acceptInvitation.subtitle: Use the invitation secret sent to you by a Platform Operator to set your password and activate your account.
acceptInvitation.invalid: That invitation isn't valid, has expired, or was already used. Ask the Platform team to resend it.

locked.title: Account Locked
locked.subtitle: Too many incorrect attempts. Your account has been locked for 3 hours. Please try again later or contact our institutional merchant support.

register.title: Create Your Merchant Account
register.subtitle: Join Yemen's unified ERP & Bank aggregator gateway
register.erpEmpty: No approved ERP systems are available yet — ask a Platform operator to add and approve one.
register.erpLoadFailed: Couldn't load ERP systems. Refresh the page to try again.
register.invalid: Fill every field. Password must be at least 8 characters and match the confirmation.

pending.title: Application received
pending.subtitle: Your merchant account stays pending until two different platform operators complete maker-checker approval. You cannot sign in until then.

shell.logoutBody: You can sign back in at any time.
shell.needsFreshLogin: Your session was restored after a reload, but making changes needs a fresh sign-in first.

dashboard.title: Dashboard

intro.operator: Pending maker-checker work, active merchants, and payment-point approval SLA (1 working day).
intro.merchant: Your Al-Amal Pharmacies payment points, integration user, and notification delivery.
intro.institution: Tadhamon Bank approvals, live points, and notification traffic for this month.

dashboard.errorsIntro: These buttons hit dummy endpoints. The error interceptor routes each status to its page.

users.title: Platform Operators
users.selfOnlyBanner: You're seeing only your own record — the full team directory is available to Admin accounts.

reissues.title: Credential Reissues
reissues.banner: First-time passwords expire 24 hours after they're prepared. These are Maker-submitted requests to replace one that expired or failed to deliver, awaiting a different Checker/Admin.
reissues.empty: No credential reissue requests to show.

products.title: Merchants
products.intro: Self-service and operator-assisted onboardings. Login is blocked until maker-checker approval. CR number is the verification key.
products.search: Search name, CR, city, or ERP
products.name: Legal name

merchants.title: Merchant Management
merchants.intro: Self-service and operator-assisted onboardings. Login is blocked until maker-checker approval. CR number is enough to approve in MVP1 — no documents required.
merchants.search: Search name, CR, city, or ERP
merchants.name: Legal name

orders.title: Payment points
orders.intro: Wallet numbers and merchant point numbers. A point stays pending until the linked bank or wallet approves it. Currencies: USD, SAR, YER.
orders.search: Search point code, merchant, or institution
orders.empty: No payment points match that search.

points.title: Payment Points
points.intro: Merchant requests a point. The bank or wallet has one working day to approve. Confirmation is a code, QR, or a tap on the notification. Currencies: USD, SAR, YER.
points.search: Search point code, merchant, or institution
points.empty: No payment points match that search.
points.approvalsEmpty: No payment points are waiting on your decision right now.
points.mineIntro: Wallet numbers and merchant points for Al-Amal Pharmacies. The linked bank or wallet has one working day to approve.
points.approvalsIntro: Pending points that Tadhamon Bank must approve or reject within one working day.
points.institutionIntro: Every merchant point and wallet number linked to Tadhamon Bank in the dummy set.
points.decideByIdCrumb: Payment Point Approvals > Decide by ID
points.decideByIdHint: Use this only if a point isn't showing in your list yet — paste its ID from the merchant and decide on it directly here.

conflict.reference: The invoice reference does not match.
conflict.noNotification: No matching notification was found for this transaction.

delivery.title: Delivery Recovery
delivery.banner: Notification deliveries needing attention — authentication-paused or dead-lettered. Approval confirms a selected configuration, not that a callback was actually received.

reason.configurationUpdated: The required configuration version has been submitted and approved
reason.operatorVerified: Operator has verified the cause has been addressed

delivery.replayHint: Creates a new delivery of the same event. Accepted/published is not proof of delivery — track the new delivery's own state.

erp.title: ERP Systems
erp.intro: ERP vendors that connect merchants into the aggregator. Checker or Admin can approve a pending connector.
erp.empty: No ERP systems match that search.
erp.name: System Name
erp.banner: Only approved ERP systems appear in merchant sign-up.
erp.incompleteWarning: This record is missing required details and won't appear in the Merchant sign-up dropdown until it's completed and approved.

requests.title: Integration Client Rotation Requests
requests.intro: Merchant credential rotation requests. Maker submits; a different Checker or Admin approves — approving reveals the new credential pair once.
requests.oneTimeWarn: This is the only time these credentials are shown. Hand them off to the requesting Merchant through your team's agreed secure process — the API will not show them again.

reports.title: Reports & Audit Log
reports.empty: No audit events match those filters.
reports.dateRangeHint: From and To must both be set to filter by date — set only one and the range is ignored.

action.deliveryReplayTerminal: Delivery replay reached a terminal state

notes.olderVersionHint: A newer version is pending review — this is your last approved version.
notes.webhookNote: Every submission creates a brand-new version for review — it does not edit the previous one. Once approved, it becomes your active callback configuration.
notes.reviewsBanner: Merchant callback configurations awaiting Maker submission or Checker/Admin decision. No merchant identity is included — work items by configuration and version.
notes.reviewsEmpty: No notification endpoint configurations have been submitted yet.
notes.fiIntro: Read-only log of payment notifications delivered via Integration API

integration.title: Integration User
integration.fiIntro: Manage secure credentials and endpoints for Financial Institution API integration.
integration.intro: Machine user that posts or reads payment notifications for your organisation.
integration.empty: No integration user is provisioned for this account.
integration.reasonPh: Please explain why you need to modify your integration credentials or URLs...
integration.checkerNote: Changes require Platform Operator approval (maker-checker process).
integration.otpNote: Unmasking credentials requires OTP verification sent to your registered email {{email}}.
integration.regenerateHint: Self-service. Triggers OTP verification, then issues new credentials immediately.
integration.requestDetailHint: Changes to URL or Port require Platform Operator approval (maker-checker process).
integration.regenerateWarn: This will invalidate your current credentials immediately. A new set will be generated after successful OTP verification.
integration.clientIntro: The machine credential your ERP/core banking system uses to call the platform's API.
integration.createHint: You don't have one yet. Creating it shows your Client ID and Secret once — copy them somewhere safe, they can't be retrieved again.
integration.oneTimeWarn: These credentials are shown only this once. Copy them somewhere safe before continuing — they cannot be retrieved again.
integration.rotationPending: A credential rotation request is pending Platform Operator approval. The approving Checker/Admin receives the new pair directly — arrange handoff with them.

profile.fiIntro: Review contract terms and manage institution contact representative details

settings.title: Account Settings
settings.intro: Dummy profile for the signed-in user. Roles follow the BRD: Admin never Maker; Checker approves; Reader is read-only.
settings.fiIntro: Update login credentials and security settings
settings.readerNote: Reader accounts cannot approve or mutate records. Navigation hides Platform Operators.
settings.rulesIntro: In compliance with Tadhamon Bank and Ultimate pay security audit requirements, passwords must meet the following:
settings.emailNotifHint: Receive approvals pending checker and audit warning emails.
settings.smsNotifHint: Receive instant alerts on critical security modifications.

institutions.title: Financial Institution Management
institutions.intro: Licensed financial institutions that send payment notifications into the aggregator.
institutions.search: Search name, license, city, or type
institutions.name: Institution Name

401.message: Your session is missing or no longer valid. Sign in again to continue.

404.title: Page not found
404.message: That route does not exist, or the resource you asked for could not be found.

501.title: Not implemented
501.message: This capability is not available yet.

503.title: Service unavailable
503.message: A required service is temporarily unavailable. Retry in a moment or return to a working screen.

validation.pattern: That value is not in the expected format.
validation.passwordStrength: Use at least 8 characters with letters and numbers.
validation.phone: Enter a phone number with at least 7 digits.
validation.uuid: Enter a valid ERP system ID (a UUID, e.g. aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa).
validation.expiryAfterSigned: Expiry date must be later than the signed date.
validation.httpsOnly: Enter a URL that starts with https://.

apiError.badRequest: The request could not be processed. Please check the form and try again.
apiError.unauthorized: You need to sign in again to continue.
apiError.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
apiError.notFound: The requested item could not be found.
apiError.conflict: This record was changed elsewhere. Reload and try again.
apiError.payloadTooLarge: That request is too large. Reduce it and try again.
apiError.unprocessable: This couldn't be verified. Check the details and try again.
apiError.locked: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
apiError.serviceUnavailable: A required service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
apiError.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
apiError.missingConcurrencyToken: Missing concurrency token — reload and try again.

toast.welcome: You're in. Let's get Yemen's rails moving.
toast.otpSent: A fresh 6-digit code is on its way.
toast.registerOk: Request received. We'll email you once a checker reviews the application.
toast.setPasswordOk: Password set — sign in with your new password.
toast.setPasswordBad: Couldn't set your password. Check the temporary password and try again.
toast.merchantSubmittedToChecker: Submitted to a Checker for approval.
toast.fiSubmittedToChecker: Submitted to a Checker for approval.
toast.fiChangeSubmitted: Profile change submitted to a Checker for approval.
toast.resetSent: If that inbox is on file, a reset link is on its way.
toast.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Sign in with the new one whenever you're ready.
toast.changeRequested: Change request is with a checker.
toast.credsRegenerated: New integration credentials are ready. Copy them now — the old pair no longer works.
toast.loginBad: That email or password doesn't match. Check them and try again.
toast.otpBad: That code isn't right. Check the code and try again.
toast.server: Something hiccuped on our side. Give it a moment and try again.
toast.network: We couldn't reach the gateway. Check your connection and retry.
toast.operatorBad: Invite needs a complete name and an @aggregator.ye work email.
toast.merchantSubmitted: Merchant is in the checker queue. They can't sign in until approved.
toast.fiSubmitted: Institution is waiting on a checker. Only approved banks and wallets show in merchant onboarding.
toast.erpSubmitted: ERP connector is queued for review. It stays off the sign-up list until approved.
toast.operatorChangeProposed: Change proposed. It takes effect once a different Checker/Admin approves it.
toast.reissueRequested: Replacement password requested. Awaiting a different Checker/Admin's approval.
toast.reissueApproved: Reissue approved. Replacement delivery has started.
toast.pointSubmitted: Payment point is with the bank. They have one working day to approve.
toast.invitationAccepted: Invitation accepted. Sign in with your new password to continue.
toast.invitationBad: That invitation could not be accepted. Check the secret and try again.
toast.deliveryReplayed: Replay requested — track the new delivery for its own outcome.

approved.merchant: Merchant is live. Their ERP can start routing payments.
approved.institution: Institution is live on the rails.
approved.erp: ERP connector is approved and will show on merchant sign-up.
approved.notification: Notification endpoint configuration is approved and active.

rejected.merchant: Merchant request was declined. They'll see the decision on their next visit.
rejected.erp: ERP connector was declined and stays off the sign-up list.

onboard.fiCrumb: Financial Institution Management > Onboard New FI
onboard.operatorDomain: The work email must belong to this environment's configured corporate domain — confirm the exact domain with the test/operations team before inviting.
onboard.grantPermissionsHint: Send the complete grant set this operator should have. An empty selection grants no permission-protected actions.

onboard.fiEmpty: No eligible financial institution is available yet.
onboard.pointNote: Note: Your payment point will be reviewed by the Financial Institution before activation.
onboard.submitError: Could not submit. Check the fields and try again.

detail.pointWarning: Verify the wallet/account number matches the merchant's registered bank details before approving.
detail.missing: This record could not be found.
detail.merchantAwaitingMaker: This self-service application is awaiting Maker review before it can move to a Checker.
detail.fiAwaitingMaker: This application is awaiting Maker review before it can move to a Checker.
detail.emptyPoints: No payment points are linked to this merchant yet.
detail.emptySettlements: No settlement records for this institution yet.

detail.changeProposedNote: Change submitted for review. It has no effect until a different Checker/Admin approves it.
detail.reissueHint: Use this only if the account's first-time password expired or failed to deliver before they could sign in. A different Checker/Admin must approve it.
detail.reissueSubmittedNote: Replacement password requested. It's pending a different Checker/Admin's approval — this doesn't confirm delivery.
